purpose: Teach: 小切手/インターンシップ/本案/公言/借り入れ/呼び名/生年月日/ベーシック

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、小切手の使用ルールを徹底しろ
lines.en: I want our company to enforce stricter check-writing protocols.
lines.style: Clipped, measured authority. Each phrase lands with quiet finality. No room for question. Professional distance — not cold, just businesslike and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インターンシップの募集を開始しました
lines.en: Understood. We've started the internship recruitment process.
lines.style: Efficient, slightly formal. Steady cadence. Respectful without obsequiousness. A simple report delivered with competence. Brief eye contact on the acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本案を取締役会で承認してもらえ
lines.en: Have this proposal approved by the board of directors.
lines.style: Terse instruction. Expectation of execution, not discussion. Controlled breath. The tone of someone giving orders he expects to be followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新方針を社員に公言いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'll announce the new policy to the staff.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Brisk, practical tone. No elaboration — just acknowledgment and immediate action plan. Professional and assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不動産の借り入れを再交渉しろ
lines.en: I need you to renegotiate our real estate loan terms.
lines.style: Direct assignment. Weight on the task itself, not the person. Steady, no inflection for negotiation — this is work that needs doing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の呼び名を社員投票で決めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll have staff vote on the name for the new product.
lines.style: Efficient delivery. Slightly less formal than the previous response — this decision involves others. Still businesslike, but a hint of collaborative process.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の生年月日管理を厳格にしろ
lines.en: Tighten up how we manage employee records — birth dates especially.
lines.style: Clear, procedural instruction. Emphasis on 'tighten' — this is about control and accuracy. Matter-of-fact. No apology in the directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人にはベーシックな研修を実施します
lines.en: Understood. All new hires will go through our standard orientation program.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, assured. The tone of someone wrapping up a meeting who has everything in hand. Professional closure.
